benchmark: NutShell L1 DCache standalone RTL microbench
measurement_source: accepted Stage2-to-Stage3 CPU READ event; MMIO/coherence excluded
clock_measurement: sampled RTL rising-edge cycles; excludes reset sweep

scenarios.name: hot_line
scenarios.description: 64 repeated reads of one cold line; first access fills the line.

scenarios.name: sequential_array_scan_4k
scenarios.description: One sequential 4 KiB array scan using 8-byte loads across 64-byte lines.

scenarios.name: working_set_fits
scenarios.description: Two sequential passes over 256 lines (16 KiB) in a cold 32 KiB DCache.

scenarios.name: repeated_array_kernel_1k_4_passes
scenarios.description: Four passes over a 1 KiB array using sequential 8-byte loads.

scenarios.name: five_way_conflict
scenarios.description: Five tags mapped to one 4-way set, replayed for 5 sweeps.
